description: Header file defining the DebugInfo class for parsing DWARF debug information in the torch::unwind namespace, including methods for parsing headers, ranges, and abbreviations, and managing debug info sections.

classes.name: DebugInfo
classes.description: Class for parsing and managing DWARF debug information sections, including methods for parsing headers, ranges, and abbreviations, and retrieving debug info offsets.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the debug info starting at a given offset.

methods.name: lineNumberProgramOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of the line number program, if available.

methods.name: nextOffset
methods.description: Calculates the next offset in the debug info section.

methods.name: ranges
methods.description: Returns address ranges from the debug info, handling rnglistx and high/low PC.

methods.name: is64bit
methods.description: Indicates whether the debug info is 64-bit.

methods.name: parseHeader
methods.description: Parses the header of a compilation unit at a given offset.

methods.name: readSegmentOffset
methods.description: Reads a segment offset, considering 64-bit or 32-bit format.

methods.name: readEncoded
methods.description: Reads an encoded value based on DWARF form encoding.

methods.name: parseCompileUnit
methods.description: Parses a compilation unit to extract attributes like low/high PC, address base, and range list base.

methods.name: readRanges4
methods.description: Reads address ranges in DWARF v4 format.

methods.name: readRanges5
methods.description: Reads address ranges in DWARF v5 format.

methods.name: findAbbrev
methods.description: Finds abbreviation entry for a given offset and entry number.
